SELECT SUM(COUNT(TT.PERSON_ID)) GROUPCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.PERSON_ID) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T WHERE T.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T.PERSON_ID = TT.PERSON_ID AND T.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) ALLCOUNT,
SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.PERSON_ID) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T WHERE T.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T.DATE_LEFT IS NOT NULL AND T.DATE_LEFT <= TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T.PERSON_ID = TT.PERSON_ID AND T.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) LEFTCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.PERSON_ID) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T WHERE T.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND (T.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR T.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND T.PERSON_ID = TT.PERSON_ID AND T.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) STAYCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE T.EMPID = HE.EMPID AND TT.PERSON_ID=HE.PERSON_ID AND (TO_DATE(T.START_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND (T.END_DATE IS NULL OR TO_DATE(T.END_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND HE.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND (HE.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HE.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND HE.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) JOINCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.PERSON_ID) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE T WHERE T.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND (T.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR T.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND T.PERSON_ID = TT.PERSON_ID AND T.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) - SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE T.EMPID = HE.EMPID AND TT.PERSON_ID=HE.PERSON_ID AND (TO_DATE(T.START_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND (T.END_DATE IS NULL OR TO_DATE(T.END_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND HE.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND (HE.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HE.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#PaMonth#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND HE.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# )) NOTJOINCOUNT FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO TT WHERE 1 = 1 AND TT.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPID LIKE 'H%')
TT.SEXCODE = #SEXCODE#
GROUP BY TT.PERSON_ID

SELECT SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T WHERE REPLACE(SUBSTR(T.START_DATE, 1, 7), '-', '') = (TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')) AND (T.END_DATE IS NULL OR (T.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND REPLACE(SUBSTR(T.END_DATE, 1, 7), '-', '') > (TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')))) AND T.EMPID = E.EMPID)) LASTCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T WHERE REPLACE(SUBSTR(T.END_DATE, 1, 7), '-', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTR(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 1, 7), '-', '') AND T.EMPID = T.EMPID)) LEFTCOUNT, SUM((SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T WHERE REPLACE(SUBSTR(T.START_DATE, 1, 7), '-', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTR(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 1, 7), '-', '') AND (T.END_DATE IS NULL OR (T.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND REPLACE(SUBSTR(T.END_DATE, 1, 7), '-', '') >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 1, 7), '-', ''))) AND T.EMPID = E.EMPID)) JOINCOUNT FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO TT, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE 1 = 1 AND TT.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPID LIKE 'H%') AND TT.PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND E.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
TT.SEXCODE = #SEXCODE:VARCHAR#

SELECT EMP.EMPID, EMP.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(EMP.DEPTNO,#language:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, TO_CHAR(EMP.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(EMP.DATE_LEFT,'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_LEFT, T.START_DATE, T.END_DATE
FROM HR_LABOR_UNION T, HR_EMPLOYEE EMP WHERE EMP.EMPID = T.EMPID(+) AND EMP.EMPID NOT IN (SELECT EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPID LIKE 'H%') AND EMP.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
EMP.DATE_STARTED < TO_DATE(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
(EMP.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR EMP.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
(EMP.DATE_LEFT IS NOT NULL AND EMP.DATE_LEFT <= TO_DATE(#paMonth:VARCHAR#, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
( T.END_DATE IS NULL OR T.END_DATE > #paMonth:VARCHAR#) AND ( T.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND T.START_DATE <= #paMonth:VARCHAR#)
((T.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND T.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND T.END_DATE <= #paMonth:VARCHAR#) OR (T.START_DATE IS NULL AND T.END_DATE IS NULL )) AND EMP.EMPID = T.EMPID
ORDER BY EMP.DEPTNO,EMP.PERSON_ID
